description.en:
MICO is Flexiv's modular dual-arm robot system, introduced in 2026 and built on the Enlight adaptive-arm platform. It combines force-sensitive manipulation with a compact architecture intended to simplify integration of embodied-AI applications. Standard configurations include Armor, Core, Plus and Ultra.

The published specification describes two seven-axis arms, with paired 5 kg payload ratings for the listed Armor, Core and Plus configurations. The different formats provide alternative levels of system integration and hardware. MICO's modular design makes the selected configuration important when assessing workspace, sensing, mobility and task requirements.
